title: Prime Minister congratulates Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil for winning a Bronze Medal at the Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra has congratulated Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil for winning a Bronze in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Asian Games. Shri Modi said that his focus and discipline were commendable throughout.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Congrats to Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil for winning a Bronze in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Asian Games event! His focus and discipline were commendable throughout. Best wishes for the endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi
Congrats to Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil for winning a Bronze in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Asian Games event! His focus and discipline were commendable throughout. Best wishes for the endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi pic.twitter.com/ossqgjKHE3 — PMO India (@PMOIndia) September 21, 2026
